import sys, json, traceback
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/project')
LIMIT = 8*1024*1024
PREFIX = ('{"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":1,"cases":[{"name":"aa","frames":[],'
          '"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}],"events":[],"channels":'
          '[{"name":"e","parts":[')
SUFFIX = ']}]}'
PIECE = '{"case":null,"data":"'
def build(size):
    parts=[]; body=len(PREFIX)+len(SUFFIX)
    unit=len(PIECE)+65000+2
    while body+unit+len(PIECE)+2+1 <= size:
        parts.append(PIECE+'x'*65000+'"'); body+=len(parts[-1])+1
    rem=size-body-1-len(PIECE)-2-len(SUFFIX)
    parts.append(PIECE+'y'*rem+'"')
    raw=PREFIX+','.join(parts)+SUFFIX
    delta=size-len(raw)
    parts[-1]=PIECE+'y'*(rem+delta)+'"'
    return PREFIX+','.join(parts)+SUFFIX
from main import run
for size in (1024*1024, 8*1024*1024):
    raw=build(size)
    doc=json.loads(raw)
    p=doc['channels'][0]['parts']
    print(size,'parts',len(p),'maxlen',max(len(x['data']) for x in p))
    try:
        out=run(doc)
        print('  ok', out['channels'][0]['error'], out['channels'][0]['bytes']['n'])
    except Exception as exc:
        traceback.print_exc()
PYEOF
